data.assumption: I interpreted “different issuing banks we saw in the UK last month” as distinct non-null issuing_bank values on non-test payment attempts for GB showrooms during August 2026, regardless of payment status.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.issuing_bank) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
WHERE pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.is_test = FALSE
  AND s.country_code = 'GB'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND pa.issuing_bank IS NOT NULL
